title: Ask Alexa+ to play rain, brown noise or nature sounds for focus or sleep
facebook: Having trouble focusing or getting to sleep? You can actually use Alexa+ as a free background sound machine — just ask it to play rain, brown noise, or nature sounds, set a timer, and it'll fade out gently when you're done. https://aiworldhq.com/article/ask-alexa-to-play-rain-brown-noise-or-nature-sounds-for-focus-or-sleep #AlexaPlus #BetterSleep
